### Making Memories
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-10-2015.html
Passage: Malachi 3:16-17
Points:
- Precious memories of shared milestones, family trips, and hardships sustain the soul over the years.
- Building a lasting store of cherished moments requires intentional time away from everyday distractions.
- Meaningful memories do not happen by accident; our choices today create what we remember tomorrow.

### The Missing Conversation in Our Accountability
Author: Ryan Griffith
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-missing-conversation-in-our-accountability
Passage: Malachi 3:13-17
Points:
- Standard accountability checklists often prove insufficient because they fail to address deeper soul care.
- Drawing from Malachi 3, believers are called to regular spiritual conversations that encourage faithful endurance.
- Ordinary Christians mutually protect and build up one another by talking candidly about God and spiritual reality.
- Sharing God's mercies and confessing personal struggles warms cold affections and reinforces gospel hope.
